mission_04: Well done! You have successfully applied VarianceThreshold to remove low-variance features. You learned how to evaluate feature variance, set an appropriate threshold, and identify which features are kept or removed. Variance thresholding is a fast and effective first-pass feature selection method. While it does not consider the relationship with the target variable, it efficiently removes features that carry minimal information. Combine it with more sophisticated selection methods like mutual information or recursive feature elimination for a comprehensive feature selection pipeline.
